text: おいかけてくるものが　いると　くらい　やまみちに　さそいこみ　さんざん　まよわせるという。

structure.jp: おいかけてくるものが　いると
structure.en: if there is someone who comes chasing it

structure.jp: くらい　やまみちに　さそいこみ
structure.en: it lures them onto dark mountain trails, and

structure.jp: さんざん　まよわせるという。
structure.en: it is said to get them thoroughly lost

patterns.name: 〜と (condition)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb means 'if' or 'whenever' that happens, the next thing follows. ものが　いると = 'whenever there is someone'.

patterns.name: 〜という (hearsay)
patterns.explanation: という at the end of a sentence means 'it is said that', for things people tell rather than things seen. まよわせるという = 'it is said to make them lose their way'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せる ending means making someone else do the action. まよう is 'to get lost', so まよわせる = 'to make someone get lost'.
